Question 9
?

Given that (x−2) is a factor of the polynomial f(x)=x3−5x2+5x+2, factor f(x) over the rational numbers.

a
(x−2)(x2−3x−1)
b
(x−2)(x2−x−1)
c
(x−2)(x2−5)
d
(x−2)(x−1)(x+1)
e
(x−2)(x2−5x−1)
